0 deg geometric alignment vs organic painted shapes

composition.balance: Top: symmetric (logo centred x 50.3-50.8). Bottom: hero low-left (37, 80) vs golem centre-right (60, 64); bottom-right crystals (61-86, 79-88) and right green crystals counterweight the hero.

measured.method: PIL + numpy colour-threshold masks and connected components; luminance grid; edge scans. Expect +/-1% on hand-rounded boxes (S1.5-S1.8, S2.x bodies, S3.x, S4.x, S5.2) which combine measured anchors with visual reading.
